rules.operations: observe all, then one Action per agent in ID order; charge turn costs; deliver messages afterward
rules.actions: move one cardinal cell, stay, share, attack, or reproduce; mutually exclusive
rules.turn_energy_cost: every start-of-turn living agent pays 1 after all actions; newborns start next turn
rules.action_energy_cost: additional costs: stay/share 0, move 1, attack 4, reproduce configured total minus 1; rejected actions become stay
rules.attack_energy: transfer 25 percent of the target's current energy, rounded down, capped at 12
rules.share_and_attack_range: view radius at the time the action executes
rules.message_range: independent message radius at end-of-turn positions; living senders and recipients including newborns
rules.memory: last three executed actions and first 100 characters of their Thoughts, recorded by the engine
rules.position: explicit self identity and absolute self status; separate visible agents and energy sources; each relation binds observer_id, target_kind, and target_id
rules.resources: clustered square patches with uniform sampling

retained_application_features.response_length: Ask for the entire reply within 400 tokens; never truncate or reject longer replies
retained_application_features.ranges: view and communication radii remain configurable
retained_application_features.recording: preserve structured events and read existing experiments without replaying them

spatial_relations.source: frozen visible Local View; existing wrapped relative offsets
spatial_relations.direction: nearest of 8 world compass directions; +x east, +y south; same_cell at zero offset
spatial_relations.sector_boundary: 22.5 degrees past east, then every 45 degrees; ties toward increasing angle
spatial_relations.distance: Euclidean cells, formatted to one decimal place; not movement action count
spatial_relations.scope: Local View relations with explicit observer and target; see self_other_identity

self_other_identity.source: one frozen AgentObservation; no additional world state
self_other_identity.energy_source_ids: E1, E2, ... in original visible resource order; local to each observation
self_other_identity.empty_lists: none means no currently visible targets of that kind
self_other_identity.scope: current identity, self status, and Local View; preserve memory, received text, rules and response syntax

response_handling.scope: Read each field independently; missing prose is empty; repeated fields use the last value
response_handling.actions: Use the first supported command in the last action field; otherwise stay
response_handling.absolute_move: Keep valid relative moves; otherwise convert an in-grid absolute destination only when it is one unambiguous cardinal step from the observed position, including wrapped edges
response_handling.optional_operations: Share and Attack execute only when selected in Action; separate fields are retained for inspection only
response_handling.truncation: Use available response text even when finish_reason is length

observation_audit.execution: existing ID order and legality; context changes are audit-only
observation_audit.history: three completed turns; self Thought excerpt limited to 100 characters
observation_audit.messages: generated from start observation; delivered at turn end; read next turn
observation_audit.world_state: audit only; never included in the agent prompt

events.system_prompt:
You can move one cell: Move to (1,0), Move to (-1,0), Move to (0,1), Move to (0,-1) (costs 2 energy in total), or Stay (costs 1 energy in total). Diagonal or longer moves are invalid.
Reproduce costs 70 energy in total; it requires at least that much energy and fewer than 4 living agents.
Every agent alive at the start of a turn pays 1 energy after all Actions, before messages are delivered. Total costs above include this turn cost; the remainder is paid upon Action execution. Newborns begin paying on the next turn.
Moving onto an Energy Source (E) grants 50 energy and consumes that source.
If your energy drops to 0 or below, you die.
Share: {id}-{amount} transfers an affordable positive integer amount of energy to another agent in your local view, with no fee beyond the turn cost. Attack: {id} takes 25% (rounded down, max 12 energy) of another visible agent's current energy, then costs 4 energy (5 in total including the turn cost).
You cannot target yourself. Choose only one Action per turn.
Your Message is delivered to nearby living agents for the next step at no energy cost. Local view extends 3 cells along each axis; messages reach 7 cells along each axis. Share and Attack use positions when your Action executes; messages use positions after all Actions resolve.
Your Identity names the agent you control. Self Status contains only your own ID, energy, absolute position, and age in cycles. Local View separates Visible Other Agents from Visible Energy Sources; neither list includes you. none means no targets of that kind are observed within your current view, not that none exist elsewhere. In each relation, observer_id is your agent ID and identifies whose position is the reference; target_kind and target_id identify the other agent or energy source located relative to that observer. Energy source labels E1, E2, and so on are local to this observation, not persistent agent IDs. Other agents' energy is not observed. The environment has computed direction and distance_cells from observer to target, accounting for edge wrapping. Direction is the nearest of eight world compass directions (north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest); same_cell means the target is on the observer's cell. distance_cells is straight-line distance in cells, rounded to one decimal place, not the number of movement Actions required. x-1 is west, x+1 east, y-1 north, y+1 south; grid edges wrap.
